externalWidgetFocalLaunches.observedOutput: all remained on 5.56 mm physical / 24 mm-equivalent main route

observedComparison.conclusion: External widget extras are parsed and normalized but did not reproduce internal Expert endpoint selection in the audited captures. Static acceptance is not runtime route success.

limitations: Exported=true plus an action/filter proves component reachability, not successful camera authorization.
CameraShortCutActivity is explicitly non-exported; launcher shortcuts can target it from the owning package, but arbitrary external callers cannot use that component directly.
Preset and widget activities with DEFAULT-only filters have no public action contract despite exported=true.
Focal extras are converted through product focal/zoom tables and mode/SAT gates; a requested focal label is not a direct camera-ID command.
Observed external fallback applies to the audited build and focal inputs only.
